slides.title: Lawyers want a slice
text: Nvidia denies wrongdoing. A judge still has to [approve the deal].
slides.source: Decrypt Nov 25 ($2.06B, 14%, 21.4% / $62M); Cointelegraph Nov 25 (14%, 21.4%); The Block Nov 25 ($62M)

sources: Decrypt, Nov 25 2026: Nvidia to pay $290M cash to settle 2018 shareholder suit (court filing Tue Nov 24); class Aug 10 2017 to Nov 15 2018; ~14% of ~$2.06B max trial damages (plaintiffs' expert); plaintiffs estimate $1.1B understated crypto GPU sales; lawyers seek up to 21.4% (~$62M); denies wrongdoing; needs court approval; stock fell ~28% over two sessions in Nov 2018

Cointelegraph, Nov 25 2026: $290M, Tuesday filing, needs court approval; class Aug 10 2017 to Nov 15 2018; $1.1B understated May 2017 to Jul 2018 (plaintiff analysis); stock -28.5% over two sessions after Nov 2018 forecast cut; 14% of damages claimed; up to 21.4% fees; dismissed 2021, revived 2023, Supreme Court dismissed Dec 2024, class certified Mar 2026; preliminary approval hearing Feb 4 2027
The Block, Nov 25 2026: $290M settlement filed Nov 24 in N.D. Cal., needs approval; up to $62M legal fees; 28.5% drop over two sessions Nov 2018; SEC $5.5M settlement 2022

Jensen Huang quote 'The crypto hangover lasted longer than we expected.': Motley Fool (Nov 18 2018, Q3 FY2019 call) and Reuters via The Express Tribune (Nov 16 2018, 'Huang said on a conference call')
